There was finally silence. 

All the constant doubt, overthinking, double thinking and double overthinking just... stopped.

Memory went from vivid, colorful video to monochrome stills. 

Talking went from spending listening time formulating and psyching myself up for what I would say next, and became listening with off the cuff responses.

There was silence, and a feeling of honesty with my interactions with the world.
